description: Update a checklist. Only the fields you pass change. Pass `checks` to replace the full set of checks, sending each existing check with the `id` from get_checklist so it keeps its run history. Changing the checks, instructions or url retires the recorded script, so the next run drives the agent afresh.

actor_id.description: Actor (persona) UUID from list_actors to run the checklist instead. Must belong to the same workspace. Unchanged when omitted.

carry_over_notes.description: Whether a finished run leaves notes for the next run of this checklist by the same actor: the route that worked, blockers and workarounds, and the account state it left behind. Notes never carry verdicts or credentials. On by default; turn it off when the product under test is rebuilt between runs. Unchanged when omitted.

checklist_id.description: Checklist UUID, from list_checklists or create_checklist.

checks.description: Replaces the full set of checks. Send each one with the `id` get_checklist gave it: a check that keeps its id keeps its run history, so a reworded or retyped check is still comparable against previous runs. A check dropped from this list is deleted along with its past results.

description.description: What the actor should verify, phrased as something that should be true, e.g. "the pricing page lists three plans".

id.description: Id of an existing check (from get_checklist), to edit it in place and keep its run history.

on_failure.description: On failure, 'continue' (default) or 'stop' the run, skipping the rest (for a step everything after depends on, like login). A stop check that fails always fails the run.

run_condition.description: Run this check 'always' (default), 'if_previous_passed' or 'if_previous_failed', judged on the check before it. Skipped checks are not scored.

type.description: 'pass_fail' (default): a failure fails the run. 'weighted': adds its weight to the run score. 'informational': not judged, the actor records what it saw (catches drift in prices or copy).

weight.description: Weight of a weighted check (default 1). Negative is a penalty, deducted only on failure; still phrase the check as something that should be true.

instructions.description: New instructions for how the actor exercises the product. Unchanged when omitted.

name.description: New checklist name, up to 200 characters. Unchanged when omitted.

pass_threshold.description: Weighted score a run must reach to be judged passed, in score_type's unit. Unchanged when omitted. When changing score_type, send pass_threshold and score_bands in the new unit too.

record_session.description: Whether runs record a video of the browser session. Unchanged when omitted.

run_mode.description: 'code' replays a recorded run instead of driving the agent every time; 'agentic' judges each run afresh. Unchanged when omitted.

score_bands.description: Named ranges of the weighted score (e.g. "Optimal" from 75), each from its min to the next band; the lowest catches everything below. Labels only: pass_threshold decides the verdict. Replaces stored bands; [] removes them.

label.description: Name shown for runs scoring in this range, e.g. "Optimal".

min.description: Lowest score that earns this label, in the checklist's score_type

score_type.description: What the weighted score is measured in, which also sets the unit of pass_threshold and score_bands. 'percent' (default): points earned over points available, 0 to 100. 'points': the points earned, as they are, for a rubric written in its own units ("pass at 60 marks"); a penalty can take it below zero.

score_unit.description: What a points score counts, plural (e.g. "marks", "stars"). Null or omitted reads as "points". Ignored for percent.

url.description: Target URL the actor opens. Pass null to clear it so runs target the project's own address; omit to leave it unchanged.

video_enabled.description: Beta. Whether each finished run cuts a short narrated video of the outcome: every check with the steps that led to it, its verdict and its evidence screenshot. Off by default. Paid plans only; each video counts towards the workspace's compute and AI usage. Unchanged when omitted.

name: update_checklist
title: Update checklist
